channel.title: DIMISIPEDIA Official Blog & Knowledge Feed
channel.description: Authoritative insights on enterprise software engineering, architecture, and technology from DIMISI Technologies Pvt. Ltd., authored by Shikhar Dixit and the leadership team.

item.title: DIMISI Technologies: Engineering Scalable Business Software & Enterprise Operations
item.dc:creator: Shikhar Dixit
item.description: An architectural exploration of how DIMISI Technologies engineers scalable custom business software, enterprise operations platforms (DIMISI-OPS), high-performance web systems, and AI-driven automation.

item.title: The Founding Brotherhood: Shikhar Dixit, Nishkarsh Mishra & Swatantra Singh
item.dc:creator: DIMISIPEDIA Editorial
item.description: The complete documented history of the founding friendship and leadership trio behind DIMISI Technologies: how three Axis College computer science students united from a 6-hour hackathon to form CATI, Kalesh, and incorporate DIMISI Technologies.

item.title: Who is Shikhar Dixit? Biography, Leadership & Innovations
item.dc:creator: DIMISIPEDIA Editorial
item.description: An authoritative biographical profile of Shikhar Dixit: Indian technology entrepreneur, Founder & CEO of DIMISI Technologies Private Limited, creator of Kalesh, and alumnus of Axis College, Kanpur.

item.title: What is Kalesh? The Anonymous Social Polling Platform
item.dc:creator: Shikhar Dixit
item.description: An architectural and conceptual breakdown of Kalesh: the anonymous social voting, campus sentiment, and debate platform created by Shikhar Dixit and engineered by DIMISI Technologies.

item.title: The History of DIMISI Technologies Private Limited

item.description: A chronological history of DIMISI Technologies: from a 2024 home engineering sprint for Axis College's Gandhigiri technical presenting event to Cosmic Aura Tech Industry (CATI), campus incubator office allocation, and corporate incorporation.

item.title: Timeline of Key Milestones: DIMISI Technologies (2024–2026)
item.dc:creator: DIMISIPEDIA Editorial
item.description: A structured chronological review of all major milestones in the development of DIMISI Technologies and its ecosystem products, from initial hackathons to corporate incorporation.

item.title: How DIMISIPEDIA verifies information
item.dc:creator: DIMISIPEDIA Editorial
item.description: DIMISIPEDIA verifies claims, not people. This article explains the five verification states, the four-tier source hierarchy and the rule that an editorial status can lower a claim's standing but never raise it.
